snippet.title: Revenant: Through The Veil - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Revenant: Through The Veil
Would you fight your way through the Egyptian afterlife to resurrect your lost love?

This is the official gameplay trailer for Revenant: Through The Veil, a 3D souls-like adventure developed in Unreal Engine 5 by Excavator Studios.

🛠️ Credits
🎬 Trailer Editing: Devin Abo
Instagram: @filmrelabo
YouTube: @devinabo

🎨 2D Animation & Storyboarding: Tahreem Cheema
🎵 Music Composition: Miguel David Rojas Salgueiro (@dimelomik26)

🎙️ Voice Talent (Instagram):
Tarek Dergham – @thadius75
Nabil El Kantar – @nabilkantar
Lames Wael Matni – @lames_ma__
Raed Nasser – @rnasser73
Hadi Akouan – @hadi_akouan
Diana Houmaidan – @di.ana_h
Kaled Houmaidan
